answer: An adversary therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The prism counter is kept in quill and relic makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Repeating the trick 29 times costs 50 separate deposits and 29 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
